title: Image Typology V2 Level 0 class - Visual content
description: Classification value from Level 0 of the Image Typology V2 taxonomy. Classifies whether the detected page region is a visual content or a non-visual region incorrectly identified as an image during layout recognition.

oneOf.title: Image
oneOf.description: A visual content intended to be classified.

oneOf.title: Not an image
oneOf.description: A non-visual page region, such as enlarged lettering, incorrectly identified as an image.

oneOf.title: Undetermined
oneOf.description: The classification could not be determined, or does not apply at this level.
